instructions: Written by the researcher (and optionally a second reader) from field knowledge, WITHOUT running the WP14 rules and without copying fixtures_v2.json.
Each case: the candidate's claim(s), the competitor(s) (a real passage with source, or a precise description), your facet coding, and your expected outcome with a short reason.
Leave a field null rather than guessing. Do not let a model fill this form: the cases are the scientific reference against which the rules are tested (MA2).
Minimum 20 cases. Required coverage is listed under required_situations; tick each case's situations.
required_situations: rival explanations with the same variables and similar results
working paper fully developing a mechanism, not peer reviewed
future-research mention followed by a full test in the candidate
one work in several versions; the journal version withdraws or changes a result
two papers jointly covering the claim's scope
two papers covering the scope with contrary findings
a correction already published / a flaw identified without correction
pooled subsample versus a separately reported condition
causal language on a correlational design
same mechanism, different market, with and without a rationale for the market
a case you believe the seven claim kinds cannot express (if any)
